_comment: 非中文文案的唯一来源。构建时（app/build.mbt）按 id 合并进 scenarios.json，缺键直接构建失败。键必须与 SCENARIOS 的 id / GROUPS 的 gid 一致。

gui.title: Desktop
gui.intro: Native desktop app development: window creation, event loops, widget layout, and rendering backends. Proton's companion modules (tray, clipboard, global hotkeys) are not listed here.

mobi.title: Mobile
mobi.intro: App development on Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, and WeChat mini programs. The registry has no consistent mobile keyword signal, so this list is hand-curated: cross-platform UI frameworks, mini-program runtimes and component libraries, native bridges, and mini-program hosts.

ui.title: Web Frontend
ui.intro: In-browser UI frameworks, reactive state, components, layout, and CSS.

tui.title: Terminal / TUI
tui.intro: Terminal interfaces, character canvases, ANSI control, and PTYs.

cli.title: CLI Argument Parsing
cli.intro: Parsing arguments, subcommands, and help text for command-line tools.

game.title: Game Engines / ECS
game.intro: Game engines, ECS architectures, procedural generation, and game backends.

graphics.title: Graphics / Charts / Rendering
graphics.intro: Vector graphics, SVG, scene graphs, charting and graph layout, drawing primitives.

img.title: Image Codecs
img.intro: Encoding, decoding, and pixel handling for image formats: PNG / JPEG / GIF / BMP / QOI / WebP.

media.title: Audio / Video
media.intro: Audio capture and playback, audio codecs, MIDI, microphones, and device interfaces.

http.title: Web Backends / HTTP Servers
http.intro: HTTP servers, routing, middleware, and backend API development.

httpc.title: HTTP Clients
httpc.intro: Making HTTP requests: request building, connection reuse, redirects, and streaming reads over SSE.

net.title: Networking / Sockets
net.intro: Transport-layer capabilities: TCP / UDP, sockets, DNS, and TLS.

proto.title: Application Protocols / RPC
proto.intro: Application-layer protocols and RPC: WebSocket, MQTT, gRPC, and SSE.

db.title: Databases / Storage
db.intro: SQLite bindings, ORMs, key-value stores, and migration tools.

async.title: Async / Concurrency
async.intro: Async runtimes, coroutines, concurrency primitives, and task scheduling.

json.title: JSON Parsing
json.intro: Parsing and generating JSON, JSON Lines, and JSON5, plus JSON Schema validation.

datafmt.title: Config / Markup Formats
datafmt.intro: Parsing and generating configuration and markup languages: YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, INI, Ion.

binfmt.title: Binary Encoding
binfmt.intro: Binary serialization formats: CBOR, Protocol Buffers, MessagePack, ASN.1.

log.title: Logging / Tracing
log.intro: Structured logging, tracing, OpenTelemetry, and metrics.

ops.title: Ops / System Administration
ops.intro: Process supervision and inspection, subprocesses and command execution, pseudo-terminal control, and CI job runners. The registry has no ops framework yet, but it does have deployable tools alongside composable libraries.
ops.note: Process managers and CI runners are ready-to-use products and count as complete solutions; the rest are single-capability libraries you assemble yourself.

llm.title: LLM / Agent / MCP
llm.intro: LLM clients, agent frameworks, MCP servers and clients, and prompting.

parser.title: Parsers / Grammars
parser.intro: Lexing, parsing, parser combinators, ASTs, tree-sitter, and parser generators.

compiler.title: Compilers / Codegen
compiler.intro: Compilers, bytecode and VMs, code generation, type checking, LLVM and native backends.

unicode.title: Unicode / Text
unicode.intro: Unicode categories, grapheme clusters, width calculation, and string utilities.

hash.title: Hashing / Checksums
hash.intro: Hash functions, message digests, HMAC, and checksums (CRC / FNV).

cipher.title: Encryption / Signing
cipher.intro: Symmetric and asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, key exchange, and certificates.

encode.title: Encoding / Escaping
encode.intro: Base64 / Base32 / Hex encoding, URL percent-encoding, escaping, and varints.

archive.title: Compression / Archives
archive.intro: Compression and decompression for DEFLATE / zlib / gzip / ZIP.

fs.title: Files / Paths / IO
fs.intro: Filesystem access, paths and environment variables, temp files, general IO abstractions, and file watching.

math.title: Math / Numerics
math.intro: Arbitrary-precision math, linear algebra, matrices, BLAS, and statistics.

ds.title: Data Structures / Algorithms
ds.intro: Ordered maps, B-trees, heaps, graph algorithms, and sets.

test.title: Testing / Assertions / Property Testing
test.intro: Unit tests, property testing (quickcheck), assertion libraries, BDD, and benchmarks.

tool.title: Dev Tooling / Code Quality
tool.intro: Code formatting, static analysis, linting, structural search and refactoring, codegen, and scaffolding.

doc.title: Markdown / Document Conversion
doc.intro: Markdown parsing, HTML/PDF/DOCX conversion, and document layout.

time.title: Time / Dates
time.intro: Date and time, time zones, RFC3339, and cron.

wasm.title: WebAssembly / JS Interop
wasm.intro: The Wasm component model, WASI, FFI, and JS bindings.
